pages.text: Press $(k:heracles.open_quests) — the quest book is your guided tour and bonus-reward track. Heracles lays out worthwhile objectives tier by tier and rewards you for completing them.

$(bold)How it fits:$() Heracles works alongside the Iridescent Codex token economy. The $(bold)Codex$() decides $(italic)when$() you advance a tier (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)); the $(bold)quests$() suggest good ways to get there and track your boss-rush progress.$(br2)$(bold)Not a gate:$() you can advance purely through the Codex without touching a quest. Quests are guidance and bonus loot — never mandatory.

$(bold)Rewards:$() completing quests grants bonus loot and extra rewards beyond the minimum needed to progress — including the skill points that feed $(l:icraft:mods_t1/pufferfish_skills)Pufferfish's Skills$(/l).$(br2)The $(bold)Submit$() buttons in the Engineering and Magic Crafting quest groups bank materials into progression tokens, same as $(bold)/icraft codex submit$().$(br2)$(bold)Next: press $(k:heracles.open_quests) and clear your first quest group.$()
